Broad sturdy parts, slightly rounded case edges, subtle worn paint, restrained details. Painterly matte game-asset material finish with medium detail, cohesive with faded teal wallpaper and dark burgundy carpet. No cord, no strap, no separate accessories, no floating elements, no thin antenna. Entire complete object centered with margin, plain light gray background, neutral even studio illumination, no dramatic shadows or reflections. No labels, text, logos, people, tabletop, room, or collage. Square image.
